rule: Until Harbor Foods renews on Oct 30, put work that helps the renewal ahead of Smart Slots and Expo work, because Harbor is 38% of revenue and is considering a competitor before signing.
For Harbor renewal work, fix Harbor's two named complaints first: the Sep 28 sync outage and the CSV export cutoff. Do the written postmortem first, because Dana Whitfield wants it in writing.
When a deliverable is due the next day, put it first, even ahead of Harbor renewal work, because the deadline is immediate. Harbor work comes right after.
When a teammate needs data for a customer meeting this week, such as Harbor's Thursday QBR, schedule it early in the week, ahead of internal feature work, because the meeting date is fixed.
